# اِغْتَنَمْتَ (iḡtanamta) /iɣ.ta.nam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# اِغْتَنَمْتِ (iḡtanamti) /iɣ.ta.nam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# اِغْتَنَمَتْ (iḡtanamat) /iɣ.ta.na.mat/: third-perso
